'''Rutian''' referred to one of the many skin tones of the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Species/Legends|species]], generally denoting a [[Color/Legends|color]] somewhere between dark blue and aquamarine. Other variations included teal and turquoise, and some Twi'leks possessed a lavender color. These were among the rarest skin hues of Twi'leks, second only to the mutated red-skinned [[Lethan/Legends|Lethans]].

Rutian Twi'leks included [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Alema Rar]], Taris native [[Mission Vao]], [[Twin/Legends|twin]] masseuses [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann Gella]] and [[Tann Gella/Legends|Tann Gella]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]], [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ara Barotta]] and missionary [[Astraal Vao]].
